question: Switch from YES+NO complement arb to buying 97–99¢ 'almost certain' winners on all 5M/15M/1H books. New bot vs patch vs mode switch?
verdict: Keep this process. Add a strategy_mode switch (complement | favorite | auto). Do not rewrite. Do not deploy a second bot. Do not turn favorite on until paper-only last-30s rules are in. Default stays complement.
why_not_new_bot: 5M/15M/1H Gamma tags are almost entirely crypto Up/Down. '不論 updown' does not add sports or a new venue. 1H also lists *-above-on-* with empty 1.00 asks — skip, as today.
Same itode 250ms, same 7% crypto fee, same WS/HTTP books, same Telegram/dashboard/Zeabur/paper sqlite. A second bot duplicates keys, WS slots, and will fight the same books.
A greenfield rewrite throws away Rev 6–10 lessons (empty 0.99 books, pair confirm, no assumed maker fills).
why_not_rewrite_in_place: Complement hunt, pair FAK/requote, merge-to-$1, and two-sided inventory are the opposite of a one-leg hold-to-settle book.
Paper cost today is shares-net on a pair. Favorite cost is price+fee, payout $1 or $0 at resolution. Mixing in one hunter will mark $0.17 snapshot ghosts as directional PnL or auto-merge a naked leg.
why_mode_switch: Share universe, WS, fees, FOK delay, dashboard, Telegram, FORCE_PAPER.
Isolate hunter + paper path + risk + inventory marking behind strategy_mode.
Only one mode may trade. Never run complement and favorite on the same capital at once.
auto = try complement (both asks +EV) first; else favorite if last-30s 97–99¢ ask still there after 250ms.

live_universe_2026_08_27T05:00Z.note: ZEC 0.99 bid 0.01 is a locked empty book, not a 99¢ favorite you can lift. Current bot already skips it. Favorite mode must skip it too.

math.payoff: At 0.99, one $25 blowup needs ~107 winning $25 fills (~+$0.23 each) to break even.

tape_study.window: closed 5M, last ~6h, skip zec, 120 markets sampled
tape_study.rule: Per market, first public BUY print in [0.97, 0.99] during last T seconds. Size min(print, $25). Fee 0.07.

T_30s.caveat: tiny n; this is exactly when MMs pull the winning ask

tape_study.honest: Prints that already filled are not your FAK after 250ms itode. Last-90s 97–99¢ is −EV size-weighted. Last-30s looks +EV on a small sample but is the same race as complement, with leftover directional blowup.

vs_complement.if_both_asks: 0.97+0.01 gross 2¢, fees ~0.27¢, locked +1.73¢/share if both fill. No steamroller. Complement strictly dominates buying only 0.97.
vs_complement.favorite_only_is_the_gap: When the cheap ask is gone and a 0.97–0.99 ask remains. That is leftover MM size on the favorite, usually pulled inside itode.

favorite_gates: same-token bid not ≤0.05 while ask ≥0.97 (skip 0.99/0.01 zec ghosts)
depth ≥ min_shares after 250ms FAK on that one leg
FORCE_PAPER; mark inventory at 0 until official resolve; never merge a naked favorite
daily loss cap counts a 0.99 blowup as ~full stake
if_built.auto: complement first if two-ask net>0 after fees and min_edge; else favorite gates
do_not: credit snapshot 97¢ fills without delayed-book confirm
run two bots or two modes at once
